name: Loner

features.name: Big Wilds
features.description: 2x2 or 3x3 wilds on the middle reels.

review:
Loner is a 5x3 slot where monitor symbols on reels 1, 3 and 5 reveal wilds, xSplits or other features. Big Wilds in 2x2 or 3x3 sizes land on reels 2 to 4, and an xSplit can split them across every position they cover.

Three monitors revealing Pin The Win starts a mini-game in which a logo bounces around the screen and pays whatever corner it hits. Nolimit rates it Extreme volatility, with a 14,999x cap.
pros: Full game playable in the official free demo
cons: Very high volatility – long dry spells are normal
Bonus buy is costly and banned in some markets (e.g. Great Britain)
Short-session results can differ widely from the RTP
